transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well... I suppose I'm just having some trouble keeping up with conversations. 

Like, down at the museum... people will be talking right to me, maybe about the next art walk or something. I’ll be looking right at them, but... then I just realize I missed the middle of what they said. I end up having to ask them to run it by me again. 

So... yeah, I just thought I should come in. That's mostly it.
Have you had this kind of difficulty following conversations since childhood?

I suppose... yeah. It's been a long time. But I guess back in grade school, my report cards would say I daydreamed a lot... or that I needed reminders to finish my work. And... well, my mother had to sit right beside me to keep me on track with my homework. That was before I was twelve, I think. So... yes.
Do you find it hard to understand other people’s intentions or social cues?
No, I don't think so. I usually understand what people mean... I just miss the words sometimes.
Do you have trouble hearing people speak, especially in noisy places?
No... my hearing is fine. I had it checked a while back. It's just... I just lose track of what they're saying.
Do you have a strong need for routines or get very upset by changes to your usual plans?
No... not really. I don't mind if plans change. It doesn't really bother me.
When you were a child, did you have trouble making or keeping friends?
No, I don't think so. I had friends growing up... didn't really have any trouble with that.
Have these attention problems gotten noticeably worse in the past few years, compared with how you used to be?

Yeah... I suppose it has. It's been more of an issue for... maybe two years and four months, roughly. That's, uh... well, that's when a friend of mine passed away. I ended up taking over the museum liaison duties all by myself after that. So... yeah, it's been more noticeable since then.
Since these difficulties became more noticeable, have you also had trouble remembering recent events?
No... not really. I remember things okay. It's just... well, just what I mentioned before.
Do you also find it hard to concentrate on reading or other tasks that require sustained attention?

Yeah, I suppose so. I'll sit down with a gallery packet or some notes... and it starts out fine. But then, after a few minutes, I realize my eyes are just moving over the page. My mind... wanders off. I end up having to read the same part over again.
Have you noticed any trouble remembering recent conversations or events that is new for you?
No, I... I don't think so. Like I said just a minute ago, my memory is fine. It's just the focusing part that's hard.
Have you been having more trouble than before remembering recent things, like conversations or events?
I... I think we just covered that. Like I said, no. My memory hasn't changed. It's just the concentration.
Have these attention problems made it harder for you to manage your usual daily tasks?

I suppose a little bit. Mostly just... with my volunteer work. The museum group has had to sort of quietly shift some of the planning pieces away from me lately. And I... well, I've just stopped feeling confident leading the art walks the way I used to. So, yes.
Did these concentration problems start only later in life, after you were already an adult?

No... I wouldn't say that. It's... well, it's been an issue for a long time. Even back in grade school. I remember my old report cards used to say things like... "daydreams," or that I needed reminders to finish my work. My mother actually had to sit right beside me just to keep me on track with my homework... that was before I was twelve. So... no, not just as an adult.
Do you have these concentration problems in more than one setting, such as both at work or volunteering and at home?
I... well, yes. I suppose so. I mentioned the museum... and at home, it's just... little things. Losing my train of thought, leaving a book half-read. It's... everywhere, I guess.
Do you also often feel restless or fidgety, like you have trouble sitting still?
No, not really. I... I don't think I have a problem sitting still. I'm usually quite quiet.
Do you often have trouble hearing or understanding speech when there is background noise?
I... no, I don't think so. I can hear fine, usually. Unless someone is mumbling, I suppose... but no, background noise doesn't really bother me.
Do you often act impulsively, like blurting things out or interrupting others?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really much of a talker, to be honest. I mostly just... keep my thoughts to myself. So, no, I wouldn't say I do that.
Do you often feel physically restless, like you need to move around or have trouble sitting still?
I think... you just asked me that. But no, I don't feel restless. I sit still just fine.
Do you feel like these attention problems are getting progressively worse over time?
I don't... I wouldn't say worse, no. I haven't really noticed a change. It's just... about the same as it's always been, I guess.
Before age 12, did you have similar attention problems at school or at home?

I suppose... yeah. It's been a long time, but... even back in grade school, my report cards usually said things like... "daydreams" or "needs reminders to finish work." And my mother... well, she used to sit right beside me just to keep me on track with my homework. That was... well before I was twelve, so... yes.
